title: Causal Provenance & Resource Attribution Model
core_invariant: A RESOURCE APPEARING AFTER AN ASTRA ACTION DOES NOT IMPLY THAT ASTRA CREATED OR OWNS IT. Temporal correlation is NOT causal ownership.

NEW_TO_WORLD.definition: A resource identity that was absent in the pre-action snapshot but present in the post-action snapshot. This is a purely observational delta and confers zero ownership or disposal rights.

TASK_CREATED.definition: A resource affirmatively created by a governed Astra action (e.g. direct Popen return, explicit launch PID, or HWND owned by the launched PID).

TASK_DESCENDANT.definition: A child or descendant process whose process tree ancestry (PPID chain) connects to an existing proven TASK_CREATED process.

PRE_EXISTING_USER.definition: A resource identity present in the pre-task baseline. Strictly preserved and protected under CRITICAL_OWNERSHIP_RULE.

EXTERNAL_CONCURRENT.definition: A resource that appeared during an Astra action interval from an independent user or operating system activity without affirmative causal linkage to the task. Strictly protected and preserved during cleanup.

UNKNOWN.definition: A resource whose origin cannot be affirmatively proven. Strictly safe: may be observed and recorded, but MUST NEVER be closed, terminated, deleted, or modified.

resource_layer_separation.observed_resources: All entities detected across the desktop in WorldFrame (windows, processes, documents, dialogs, files).
resource_layer_separation.new_resources: Entities present in post-action frame but absent in pre-action frame (NEW_TO_WORLD).
resource_layer_separation.causally_attributed_resources: Entities with affirmative causal provenance connecting them to the task (TASK_CREATED, TASK_DESCENDANT).
resource_layer_separation.task_owned_resources: Subset of causally attributed entities that the task actively governs.
resource_layer_separation.disposable_resources: Task-owned resources whose goal-required final state is disposable (eligible for verified cleanup).

affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.A_DIRECT_GOVERNED_LAUNCH: Process PID returned directly from Astra's governed ExecutionBroker launch operation (e.g. subprocess.Popen.pid or Win32 CreateProcess PROCESS_INFORMATION.dwProcessId).
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.B_GOVERNED_LAUNCH_TARGET: Process identity explicitly observed as the exact intended target of the governed launch operation.
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.C_DESCENDANT_PROCESS: Descendant process whose ancestry can be traced via the OS process tree (PPID chain via psutil) to a proven TASK_CREATED ancestor.
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.D_HWND_OF_TASK_PID: Top-level Win32 window HWND whose owning PID (via GetWindowThreadProcessId) belongs to a proven TASK_CREATED or TASK_DESCENDANT process.
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.E_STRUCTURAL_CHILD: UIA document, tab, pane, or control whose parent HWND is a proven task-owned window.
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.F_DIALOG_OF_TASK: Dialog window whose parent HWND or owning PID is a proven task-owned resource.
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.G_TASK_DECLARED_ARTIFACT_SCOPE: File created inside an explicitly declared task-owned artifact or temp scope path by the governed action.
affirmative_causal_evidence_rules.H_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED_RELATION: Another affirmative, machine-verifiable causal link proven by kernel or runtime tracing.

safety_invariants_for_unknown_and_concur: Temporal coincidence ('absent before + present after') is NEVER sufficient to establish ownership.
UNKNOWN and EXTERNAL_CONCURRENT resources MUST NOT be closed.
UNKNOWN and EXTERNAL_CONCURRENT resources MUST NOT be terminated.
UNKNOWN and EXTERNAL_CONCURRENT resources MUST NOT be deleted.
UNKNOWN and EXTERNAL_CONCURRENT resources MUST NOT be modified during lifecycle cleanup.
Lifecycle completion distinguishes unknown unrelated world delta from unresolved task-owned resources.
generic_architecture_guarantee: No brand-specific, process-name, or window-title hacks. Causal provenance is determined purely through OS process trees, Win32 window-thread relationships, UIA structural ancestry, and declared artifact boundaries.
